formulaBlock.normalization: No split entries; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3) and Coco-Glucoside (4); no reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Refatters Glyceryl Oleate (13), Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate (15) are minor.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (8, prominent), plus light routes (Glyceryl Oleate 13, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate 15) and humectants Panthenol (5), Glycerin (9). C2 not met: no silicone, payload lipid or pearlizing route.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Single polymer with weak refatters; low is realistic.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one light cationic guar and weak refatters against a buffered SLES chassis; nothing persistent.

persistence.rationale: No silicone, lipid, protein or film former.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Single light polymer plus weak refatters with moderate reset: low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: the only families are one guar and weak_refatter esters (plus humectants); no silicone, lipid, protein or film converges and the SLES chassis offsets light residue.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Piroctone Olamine (10) plus prominent comfort routes Panthenol (5), Bisabolol (6), Niacinamide (7), fragrance-free: scalp-care architecture; needs a qualifying claim. Lengths care-direction: nonspecific.
